title: Frog at rest

source.why_this_clip: A large toad sits facing the camera in the middle of a bare floor and stays almost still, with small shifts of its head and throat. The interval ends at 3.25 s because the shot cuts to an orangutan at 3.5 s, and it starts after the first frames to keep 2.5 s of the frog alone.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected16raw source samples spanning the retained interval and boundary margins in preflight-source.jpg. One continuous event; no internal cut/dissolve observed.
